text: Two automatic tasks keep the pharmacy on schedule: the order list, so items get ordered, and the weekly Vet Snap upload, so our controlled-drug patients are reported.
The one thing to remember: the order-list task opens your office's order list, and the Vet Snap task closes as soon as anyone downloads the file.
When someone adds an item to an office's order list, the Inventory Manager for that office gets a task two hours later.
Open Raleigh office order list takes you straight there to place the order.
Once it's placed, come back and click Mark ordered. It also clears itself once the order list is empty.
Every Thursday morning, the practice manager gets the Vet Snap task.
It says where the file is.
Click Vet Snap patients, last fourteen days, then upload the file to Vet Snap.
It shows who downloaded it last. The task closes itself within half an hour.

The most common mistakes: marking the order-list task done before the order is placed, and downloading the Vet Snap file without uploading it. Remember: the order-list task opens your office's order list, and the Vet Snap task closes as soon as anyone downloads the file.
